deployments_detail.use: "ACS RTDI" real-time data infra + NVIDIA ML for AI-driven semiconductor test systems (verification → prediction)

ACS RTDI (Real-Time Data Infrastructure) integrated with NVIDIA AI inference and GPU-accelerated ML, selected by NVIDIA for high-volume production to optimize test parameters in real time for Blackwell and next-generation AI chips [NVIDIA]

Planned incorporation of NVIDIA NeMo and NVIDIA NIM microservices into ACS test analytics to curate heterogeneous production data, evaluate models, and deploy generative AI agents inside test environments [NVIDIA (NeMo, NIM)]

Advantest Power Optimization Solution (APOS) for V93000 SoC test platform using AI/ML to optimize power management, automatically enable/disable test cards, and provide real-time energy monitoring; launched and installed at multiple customer sites [Advantest (with NVIDIA ML per Oct 2025 release)]

ACS RTDI platform with ACS Edge Server and ACS Nexus performing AI/ML inference and adaptive analytics at the edge (millisecond latency) inside the test cell for real-time defect detection and corrective action during chip production [Advantest ACS]

Advantest uses ACS Nexus real-time data streaming integrated with Synopsys SiliconDash analytics deployed in production across its own global manufacturing and test facilities to increase yield via real-time root-cause identification and outlier screening [Synopsys (SiliconDash)]

Strategic collaboration with Emerson (NI) to build an AI-driven test ecosystem pushing complex compute and AI/ML models to the edge for real-time re-binning and adaptive testing across wafer sort, final test, and system-level test [Emerson / NI]

Collaboration with PDF Solutions and proteanTecs harnessing AI/ML for yield, quality and reliability; proteanTecs Edge AI/ML applications deployed on the tester as part of the Advantest ACS Solution Store [PDF Solutions, proteanTecs]

Pilot/prototype using the ACS Gemini digital twin linking real test equipment with a virtual twin to apply adaptive AI/ML test logic in near real-time, reducing test time while maintaining defect coverage [Advantest ACS Gemini]

ACS Gemini Digital Twin software solution launched to let developers create, simulate, test, and debug machine-learning applications for the test cell (SDK, reference application development model, containerized environment) [Advantest ACS]
